Setup
=====

1. Clone the repository

.. code-block:: bash

    git clone https://github.com/DaGuinci/menuMaker.git


Need to have a Mysql server running, an existent database named menumaker_dev and a .env file as :

.. code-block:: python
    
        DB_USER=root
        DB_PASSWORD=root


2. Run the server

.. code-block:: bash

    mvn spring-boot:run
